name: AWS — Console Login From Multiple External IPs
xql_query:
dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin"
| alter login_outcome = arrayindex(regextract(responseElements, "\"ConsoleLogin\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        identity_type = arrayindex(regextract(userIdentity, "\"type\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(userIdentity, "\"userName\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        arn = arrayindex(regextract(userIdentity, "\"arn\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter login_outcome = "Success"
       and identity_type = "IAMUser"
       and user_name != null
       and sourceIPAddress != null
| filter not (user_name contains "svc-"
       or user_name contains "terraform"
       or user_name contains "jenkins"
       or user_name contains "github-actions"
       or arn contains "AWSServiceRoleFor"
       or arn contains "/aws-service-role/"
       or arn contains "InstanceProfile")
| alter ip_16 = arrayindex(regextract(sourceIPAddress, "^(\d+\.\d+)\."), 0)
| filter ip_16 != null
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count_distinct(sourceIPAddress) as distinct_ips,
       count_distinct(ip_16) as distinct_networks,
       values(sourceIPAddress) as ip_list,
       count() as logins
       by user_name, _time
| filter distinct_networks >= 3 and distinct_ips >= 3
| fields ip_list, user_name
description: Same IAM user successfully logged into AWS console from ≥2 distinct non-RFC1918 source IPs within one hour.
alert_name: AWS — Console Login From Multiple External IPs
